data.one_liner: Video orchestration library for controller pooling, visibility lifecycle, and disk caching.
data.what_it_does: Video_pool manages a fixed pool of player instances to prevent freezing, memory leaks, and overheating in video feed apps. It reuses players as the user scrolls, handles visibility tracking, thermal throttling, disk pre-fetching, and system audio focus.
use_when: Building TikTok, Reels, or Instagram-style video feeds
Needing smooth 60fps scrolling without decoder teardown and GC pressure
avoid_when: Playing a single isolated video player without scrollable feeds
strengths: Intelligent controller pooling with zero-jank scrolling
Automatic thermal throttling and memory pressure management
Built-in disk pre-fetching and HLS fast-start tuning
weaknesses: Requires media_kit platform setup for iOS and Android
May require platform-specific pod install steps
data.setup_notes: Follow media_kit platform preparation guides for iOS (Podfile/Swift Package Manager) and initialize MediaKit in main().

alternatives.name: video_player
alternatives.why_pick_it: You want the official standard video player plugin without orchestration pooling overhead or external backend dependencies.

alternatives.name: just_audio
alternatives.why_pick_it: You primarily need advanced audio streaming and playback features instead of video feed orchestration.

data.minimal_example:
VideoPoolScope(
  config: const VideoPoolConfig(maxConcurrent: 3, preloadCount: 1),
  adapterFactory: (_) => MediaKitAdapter(),
  sourceResolver: (index) => videos[index],
  child: VideoFeedView(sources: videos),
)
